summary: Iter-19 tested the new Courier KPI module end-to-end. Backend pytest (11/11 PASS) verified Courier CRUD (create/list/update-color/soft-delete + include_inactive), KPI entries upsert idempotency, validation (percent>100 → 400, invalid month YYYY-13 → 400), entry delete, aggregated /data (rolling window MAR-25→FEB-26 with 12 months, calendar 2025 Jan-Dec), and ISO modules registry contains 'Courier KPI' under 'Operations'. Frontend Playwright E2E verified: empty-state add-courier flow, creating JET / Toll / StarTrack, tabs render with data-testids ck-tab-JET/Toll/StarTrack, KPI entry dialog persistence (86.2/13.8/97.2/2.8 saved and averages text updates), period Rolling↔Calendar switching (ck-year input appears), comparison tab shows all 4 required chart cards (2 line + 2 bar) plus Averages Summary table listing all 3 couriers, Manage tab edit dialog pre-fills existing values, and Print popup opens with title 'Courier KPI Report' + ISO footer '—' placeholders (no crash when Document Control has no entry). One frontend defect found in Print flow (see action_items).

ui_bugs.issue: Print button only captures Chart.js canvases currently mounted in the DOM. Because Radix Tabs unmount inactive TabsContent, printing while on the Manage or Comparison tab produces a popup with header/footer but NO per-courier chart pages (perCourierBlocks is empty). To reproduce: create couriers, add entries on JET, switch to 'Manage Couriers' tab, click Print — resulting popup shows 'No courier data available.'

After creating/editing a courier from the 'Manage Couriers' tab, fetchData() force-switches activeTab to the first courier tab (because 'manage' is not in couriers list). User has to click 'Manage Couriers' again to add another courier. In fetchData, the condition `!res.data.couriers.find(c=>c.id===activeTab)` treats non-id values ('manage','compare') as invalid and forces a switch. Should exempt 'manage' and 'compare' from that logic.

issues: DialogContent for Add/Edit Courier and KPI Entry dialogs emit React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Add DialogDescription for screen readers.

action_items: Fix handlePrint() to render all courier tab contents into a hidden container (or use forceMount on TabsContent) before capturing canvases, so Print works regardless of the tab the user is currently viewing.
In fetchData(), skip the activeTab reset when activeTab is 'manage' or 'compare' so users can add multiple couriers back-to-back without re-clicking the Manage tab.
Add DialogDescription (aria-describedby) to Add/Edit Courier and KPI Entry dialogs to remove the Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: handlePrint() depends on transient DOM state (canvases only exist when their TabsContent is mounted). For a print/report feature this is fragile — offscreen render or forceMount is required.

PUT /api/courier-kpi/couriers/{id} `updates` filter uses `v is not None or k == 'active'` which means passing active=None (from CourierUpdate default) still bypasses the None-filter for 'active' and could accidentally write None into the doc. Consider using exclude_unset only, or explicitly checking payload.dict(exclude_unset=True).

Backend has NO admin/role gating on any Courier KPI endpoint — any authenticated user can create/delete couriers and edit any month's KPIs. If Courier KPI is meant to be admin-controlled (as the review request implies: 'as admin'), add a role check similar to other ISO modules.
Backend duplicates the MongoDB client creation pattern (each route file re-creates AsyncIOMotorClient). Consider a shared db module. Not blocking.

prettyMonth() and _month_label() define the month-name array in two places (backend Python + frontend JS). Fine for now, but if you ever localise or change casing (e.g. 'JUL' vs 'Jul'), both must be edited together.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (Print-button bug is the only functional miss; empty state, add courier, KPI entry, tab switching, period switching, comparison charts, manage tab edit all PASS)

seed_data_creation: Test session created & DELETED (soft) 4 couriers (TEST_JET/Toll/StarTrack/DeleteMe) via pytest and 3 couriers (JET, Toll, StarTrack) + one KPI entry via UI. All UI+pytest data cleaned up at end — verified GET /api/courier-kpi/couriers returns empty active list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend collections used: `couriers` and `courier_kpi_entries`. Soft-delete pattern: DELETE /couriers/{id} sets active=false; historical entries preserved. Idempotent upsert on /entries keyed by (courier_id, month). Test file /app/backend/tests/test_courier_kpi_iter19.py can be re-run any time — it creates TEST_ prefixed couriers and cleans them at teardown. Frontend selectors verified: ck-empty-add-courier, ck-tab-{name}, ck-tab-compare, ck-tab-manage, ck-add-courier (only visible on Manage tab), ck-courier-name, ck-save-courier, ck-edit-courier-{name}, ck-delete-courier-{name}, ck-entry-on-3hr/late-3hr/on-4hr/late-4hr, ck-save-entry, ck-period, ck-year, ck-end-month, ck-print. Known gotchas: (1) After saving a courier from Manage tab, activeTab resets to first courier tab — must re-click ck-tab-manage. (2) Chart.js labels are drawn on canvas, NOT in DOM text — do NOT assert on axis labels via inner_text; use screenshot or check dataset config instead. (3) Print popup only contains data for currently-mounted tab (see MEDIUM bug in action_items).
rca_of_the_issue: Print-button-empty-when-not-on-courier-tab: root cause is Radix UI <TabsContent> unmounts by default when the tab isn't active. handlePrint() calls captureCanvas(`ck-chart-3hr-${c.id}`) which querySelectors the DOM — when the JET/Toll/StarTrack TabsContent isn't currently active, its <canvas> element does not exist, so captureCanvas returns '' and perCourierBlocks becomes empty. Fix options: (a) add forceMount to each TabsContent, (b) temporarily programmatically switch through each tab before print (bad UX), or (c) render an offscreen hidden print-only container that always mounts all charts. Option (a) is simplest.
